notes.title: Update content for February 28th: New synchronization achievement function added
notes.notes:
Dear doctors, the latest update announcement is as follows:

1. Added a synchronization achievement button, which can be used to detect and synchronize Steam achievements, solving the problem of achieving achievements in the game but not triggering Steam achievements

2. Optimized the detailed experience

Official QQ group: 869659334

Welcome to join the QQ group. Feel free to give feedback to our assistant if you have any questions~
Wishing everyone a pleasant trip!

notes.title: Update content for August 2nd: Added keyboard controls
notes.notes:
Update content for August 2nd: Added keyboard controls

Dear Dr. Chatelet, in order to facilitate you in performing bloodletting and amputation surgeries, and save more patients, we have added keyboard controls.

1、Bloodletting treatment can now be controlled using the space bar on your keyboard for preparation and making the incision;

2、For amputation surgeries, use the A/D keys on your keyboard to control the amputation.

Official QQ Group: 869659334

Everyone is welcome to join the QQ group, and feel free to report any issues to the assistant at any time.

Hope you all have a great gaming experience!
